project.name: Jolly Roger Charter (charter repository)
project.description: Founding documents, draft JRCv1 standard, website and the jrc conformance tool.

assessment.assessor: Claude Opus 5.5 (AI agent), for the human initiator
assessment.method: Self-assessment written by the agent that built most of this repository, checked with jrc 0.1.0. Nobody unaffiliated has reviewed it.

claims.statement: Original content is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0, with exclusions listed.
All build dependencies are pinned in a lockfile; the jrc tool itself has no runtime dependencies.

gaps: No per-dependency licence inventory has been generated for the npm build dependencies.
The CC0 dedication has not been reviewed by counsel; CC0 does not waive patent rights.

claims.statement: A fresh clone builds and tests with no credentials using two commands.
The prompts, plans and agent run records that produced this repository are published.
Contributor and agent instructions are in the repository, with no dependency on one AI vendor.

gaps: The founding ChatGPT conversation is summarised, not published; the transcript awaits an export and human review.
Session transcripts of the agent runs are summarised in run records, not published in full.

data.applicability: The charter site is static. It has no accounts, forms, cookies or analytics, and stores no user records, so there is nothing to export or migrate. This changes when a reference application such as Quartermaster holds user data.

claims.statement: Deployment is documented for three interchangeable static hosts, with rollback by git revert.

gaps: Only one host is deployed, in one person's account; no mirror exists yet.
No incident or security-response procedure is written down.

claims.statement: Operating costs are published with sources, and unknown amounts are shown as unknown.

gaps: AI usage costs for the founding conversation and the build sessions are unknown.
Human attention has not been measured; no valuation method has been adopted.

claims.statement: Anyone can propose changes or object through issue templates and GitHub Discussions.

gaps: One person can merge and administer everything; a second owner has been invited but has not joined.
No decision rule, maintainer process or succession plan has been adopted.

limitations: Written by the AI agent that built most of what it assesses; treat it as a starting point for criticism, not a verdict.
Independent reproduction: NOT YET VERIFIED. No unaffiliated person has rebuilt or redeployed this project.
This is not a certification. No one has certified it, and no one has endorsed it.
